title: Real-World Outcomes of Aflibercept 2 mg Using a Treat-and-Extend Protocol for Neovascular Age-Related Macular Degeneration: A 24-Month Retrospective Study in a Chinese Population

condition: Treatment-naive neovascular age-related macular degeneration (newly diagnosed by FFA and/or OCTA; no prior anti-VEGF or photodynamic therapy); retrospective single-arm, single-centre real-world cohort (China); intravitreal aflibercept 2 mg as initial anti-VEGF therapy, three monthly loading injections then treat-and-extend; inclusion required completion of at least 24 months of follow-up

groups.description: All included eyes, one cohort (Results: eyes included): three consecutive monthly loading injections, then treat-and-extend (interval lengthened in 2-week steps up to 16 weeks without fluid or haemorrhage, shortened by 2 weeks with disease activity; treatment suspended with 16-weekly monitoring after three consecutive 16-week intervals without recurrence)

cells.definition: definition:Table 1 (t0001) footnote tfn0001: Δ represents the change from baseline (mean ± SD), so the change at baseline is 0

series.baseline_label: Baseline (Table 1 column 2, CMT row R3; reference cell)
series.notes: Mean ± SD (Table 1 footnote; Statistical Analysis: continuous variables as mean ± SD or median (IQR), these cells use ±). Follow-up cells are Δ-prefixed mean changes from baseline (the builder skips the leading change sign). n = eyes at baseline; per-visit n for CMT not reported; the percentages of the categorical rows of Table 1 imply 37 eyes at baseline and 3 months, 36 at 6, 12 and 18 months and 35 at 24 months (ordinary attrition kept); handling of missing visits (observed cases or LOCF) not stated. Visit columns used at their nominal months from the baseline visit (no visit window stated).

notes: Single-arm retrospective real-world cohort of a marketed agent without an investigational arm: role control.

Time origin: baseline visit (first aflibercept injection). Table 1 columns '3 Months' to '24 Months' used at nominal months; no visit window stated; month 3 is one month after the third monthly loading injection (months 0, 1 and 2).
Measure: the Methods define CMT as the mean retinal thickness within the central 1-mm ETDRS subfield (the same sentence also lists IRF, SRF and PED), so central_subfield.
Device: Heidelberg Engineering spectral-domain OCT ('Spec-TR-04283'; Figure 2 shows a Heidelberg scan), so spectralis.
Treatment suspension after three consecutive 16-week intervals without recurrence is part of the regimen; no values were removed or replaced after it (means over all included eyes).
Inclusion required completion of at least 24 months of follow-up (follow-up completion, not an outcome-defined group).
No table gives follow-up absolute CMT: Table 1 gives the baseline thickness and the changes from baseline, so value kind thickness_change with Table 1 R3C2 as the reference cell.
BCVA, PED height, subfoveal choroidal thickness, OCT biomarker proportions, number of injections and logistic regression results exist but are not extracted.
nAMD subtype (for example polypoidal choroidal vasculopathy) not stated.
